_note: Baked in-engine with the rig's measured convention applied, so row d of every sheet depicts heading 360*d/dirs. Anchor cell px are TOP-LEFT origin, per direction row then per frame column. 'tool' is the prop grip for the rod/shovel states; 'carry' holds one block per stance the rig allows on that anim. Props pin from these at RUNTIME and are never baked into the sheet.
